text:
Zara Khan: Proposal: 4-week pilot for a 'postmortem sprintlet' to close actions faster. low ceremony.
Ben Holt: sounds good. what are the beats?
Zara Khan: owners get three nudges: 48h ack, 7d unblock, 14d close-or-escalate. one weekly 25m sprintlet for active owners.
Maya Singh: +1. suggest a tiny timeline doc: day0, day2, day7, day14 with exact owner steps.
Ben Holt: add a repeat-detection flag: same component in 2 incidents in 60d -> mark for RCA follow-up.
Priyanka Das: can we keep steward separate from IC? IC handles live, steward owns follow-through.
ops-bot: reminder created: "postmortem-sprintlet-pilot" -> sends DMs at 48h and 14d
Zara Khan: communications: templated one-line pings only. example DM: "hi <owner>, quick status on PM action #<id>? blockers? ETA?"
Maya Singh: i'll draft the timeline and a one-page steward cheat-sheet.
Ben Holt: I'll build a tiny script for the repeat-flag based on incident tags. aim to share proto by Fri.
Priyanka Das: I'll make the scoreboard sheet with columns: owner | action | due | status | repeat-count.
Zara Khan: escalation: owner -> steward -> oncall lead -> eng manager. volunteers for steward rota, fallback to oncall lead after 48h.
Ben Holt: metrics to track: median time-to-close, % closed by 14d, recurrence count.
Maya Singh: pilot scope: infra + platform only for 4 weeks. then review with SRE.
Zara Khan: action list: Maya: timeline + cheat-sheet; Ben: repeat script; Priyanka: scoreboard. start next Monday.
Priyanka Das: signing up for week 1 steward slot.
Ben Holt: no objections. :+1:
Maya Singh: :thumbsup:
Zara Khan: thanks all, will post pilot doc and signup link tomorrow.
